unit.why: A short narrative: R. Hayyim Meir Yehiel of Mogielnica travels to R. Zvi Hirsh of Rymanów on R. Israel of Ruzhin's advice, and the Rymanów rebbe, seeing him eat little, whispers a teaching to him. A further homily follows.
unit.boundary_note: the division ends with a separate homily of the Rymanów rebbe (מעין עוה״ב), quoted from Be'erot ha-Mayim

stories.end_quote: להשגת יראת שמים וזהו מעין עוה״ב עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: On R. Israel of Ruzhin's advice, R. Hayyim Meir Yehiel of Mogielnica travels with his son-in-law to R. Zvi Hirsh ha-Kohen of Rymanów, who sees that he eats little and whispers to him a teaching on why Sabbath eating is a 'handle' for receiving Sabbath holiness; a homily on Sabbath as a foretaste of the world to come follows.
